text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 router latency breach detected (eu-west-2). Streaming requests showing stalls; p95 also elevated. Thresholds crossed: p99 > 1200ms, p95 > 350ms. Auto-pager triggered. :rotating_light:

alex: I see it on the dashboard — ingestion -> router -> lb path. Spikes started ~1712349400, ramping at ~1712349800.

maya: ack, oncall. Jumping on bridge in 2. grabbing histograms.

ryan: +1, checking recent routing policy rollouts. I can see a weight change to prioritize local shards rolled at 1712349000.

emily: I'm seeing a correlated increase in hot-partition errors on router-03 and router-07 (eu-west-2a/b). Stream stalls align with those hosts.

chris: any deploys to ingress or lb yesterday? I didn't see infra deploys but there was a config push to routing-policy service earlier.

alex: routing-policy version v3.4.1 pushed at 1712348850. It added a new prefer-local affinity heuristic.

maya: can someone dump the per-shard qps for router-03? suspect hotkey or fanout.

ryan: running: 
```
curl -sS http://ops-metrics/api/routers/eu-west-2/03/shards | jq '.shards|sort_by(.qps)|reverse[:10]'
```

ryan: output shows shard-0a6 -> 12k rps, shard-ff1 -> 10.2k rps, others << 1k. That's a hot partition.

emily: streaming clients on those shards report persistent head-room exhaustion; KV cache eviction rates spiking.

laura: tagging product-impact: several customers on streaming plan reported increased timeouts and reconnects. CS already pinged one enterprise customer; they see partial transcript loss.

maya: priority actions: 1) mitigate hot shard routing (evacuate or redistribute) 2) roll back prefer-local heuristic 3) scale LB behind the routers if helpful.

alex: I can flip a temporary override to routing-policy to reduce affinity weight to 0 for eu-west-2 while we triage. Want me to do that?

ryan: do it. Also plan to add a drop-in fallback that routes overflow to eu-west-1 as a spill. Will need approval for cross-region routing for some tenants.

alex: applying override now: `POST /ops/routing/overrides {"region":"eu-west-2","heuristic":"prefer_local","weight":0}` ---> 200 OK.

incident-bot: action taken: routing override applied by alex at 1712349999.

maya: monitoring effect. dashboards show initial p99 drop from ~1400ms -> ~900ms within 30s. p95 down to ~300ms. Not back to normal yet.

chris: I'm starting targeted drain of router-03's hottest shards to router-10 and router-11. Command: `./router-admin drain-shard --router 03 --shard shard-0a6 --target router-10`

emily: drain started. metrics indicate queue length on router-03 for that shard falling.

laura: CS update: notified affected customers about degraded quality and that we're rolling mitigations. One customer asked for ETA; gave tentative 30-45m.

ryan: I also see LB connection churn on lb-euw2-1 around the same timestamps; investigating. Might be that affinity change caused sticky sessions to bunch.

chris: added temporary autoscale on LB pool euw2-edge -> +3 instances, min 6. `./infra scale-lb --pool euw2-edge --delta +3`

alex: routing rollback considered — prefer-local change is likely the root cause. Recommend a rollback of v3.4.1 to v3.4.0 for eu-west-2.

maya: agree. Do a canary rollback to 10% of traffic first? but we already applied override weight=0 which is similar. Can still rollback policy to avoid re-introduction on redeploy.

ryan: initiating rollback for routing-policy on eu-west-2 to v3.4.0. Command: `./deploy rollback routing-policy --region eu-west-2 --to v3.4.0 --canary 0.1`

incident-bot: rollback started by ryan at 1712350300. Canary 10% -> monitoring.

emily: within 5 minutes canary traffic p99 ~320ms, p95 ~180ms. Good sign.

laura: CS: customers asking if this could have caused data loss; reassured that transcripts are eventually consistent and streaming checkpoints intact; only transient disconnects.

maya: oncall handoff — alex you can take notes, I'm staying on for the next 20m to watch rollback. If things stabilize, we'll resolve and file a postmortem.

alex: taking notes. Recorder: root cause likely routing-policy prefer-local heuristic causing hot-partition skew; cascade to LB sticky connections amplified tail. Mitigations: override weight=0, drain hot shards, LB autoscale, canary rollback to v3.4.0.

chris: logs to attach for postmortem: `router-03/containers/streamer/2026-03-15-17*.log`, `routing-policy/commit-abc123/changes.diff`, `lb-euw2-1/connstats-1712349*.csv`.

ryan: recommend follow-ups: 1) add throttling on per-shard qps to avoid single shard bursts 2) add pre-deploy simulation for routing heuristics using historical traffic 3) improve cross-region spill policy opt-in flags for enterprise tenants.

emily: metrics show p99 back to baseline ~1712350800. streaming stalls reduced, reconnects dropping.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: p99 latency recovered to baseline. No active customer-impacting errors reported in last 10m.

maya: resolving pager in ~10m if stable. Will open postmortem ticket and assign owners: root-cause analysis (ryan), mitigations & infra changes (chris), customer comms follow-up (laura), evals & perf tests (emily).

laura: leaving a note for CS follow-up and an incident summary for customers. Thanks all. :heart:

alex: thanks team. handing to maya for wrap.

maya: closing incident thread. final note: temporary override remains until routing-policy is permanently rolled back and we validate. File incident PM with timeline and attach logs.

sre-bot: Generated incident ticket #INC-2026-0452 with severity P1. Links: https://redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-0452

alex: verified ticket created and linked.

maya: last check: all metrics green. I'm removing myself from active watch but reachable. If anything flares, ping @oncall.

chris: leaving a short runbook entry: "If prefer-local rollout causes p99 spikes, set override weight=0, drain hotspots, autoscale LB, and rollback policy."

emily: +1 to runbook. Will add graphs and sample commands.

laura: closing from CS side once postmortem draft is ready.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED at 1712351200.
